name: inspect_native_load_image
description: Inspect the provider's measured source digests, memory mappings, relocations, entry points and entry register context. Ghidra relocation symbols are provider observations, not runtime binding proof; older Evidence may not record them. Independent snapshot verification supports DOS MZ, explicitly selected COM, raw binaries and GameCube DOL; other formats retain their observations with unsupported verification. Overlay and uninitialized coverage remain explicit. Select detail summary for verification state and counts, retaining complete Evidence for inspect_analysis_view kind native-load-image: collection source_files, mappings, relocations, entry_points, entry_context, checks or sections, with indices, fields and offset/limit paging. Relocation bytes and check expected/observed payloads require explicit fields; defaults keep metadata. Null collections are unrecorded or inapplicable. Does not execute or modify the target.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.
